Container.Name: mustarrd
Container.Overview: Mustarrd is an IPTV catchup direct downloader for Xtream Codes providers. Browse EPG history, queue catchup downloads, schedule future recording downloads, remove commercials, and save files for media player apps.
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate my work, then please consider buying me a beer :D

Config.Name: Port: mustarrd
Config.Description: This is the port for the application.

Config.Name: Path: /config
Config.Description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

Config.Name: Temp Processing Files
Config.Description: In-progress downloads and temp processing files

Config.Name: Processed Media
Config.Description: Final output location for completed files

Config.Name: VAAPI Driver
Config.Description: VAAPI driver name for hardware-accelerated transcoding. Intel (default): iHD (newer) or i965 (older). AMD: radeonsi. Leave blank to let Mustarrd auto-detect the driver. To turn off GPU transcoding, select CPU in Settings or remove the GPU Device passthrough.

Config.Name: GPU Device
Config.Description: Optional Intel/AMD GPU passthrough for ffmpeg acceleration

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the running container
